t: The Notebook as Orchestrator: A Smarter Workflow for Python and AI
s: This article advocates using Jupyter Notebooks as orchestrators that call functions from separate `.py` files to improve Python and AI development workflows. It emphasizes 'working smarter' by leveraging modularity, command-line AI tools, and the Unix philosophy.
sub: Modular Python code (`.py` files) for core logic
Command-line AI tools and Unix pipes for AI integration
Separation of concerns: Notebook for workflow, `.py` for logic
